description: This file defines hashing utilities within the c10 namespace, including hash_combine, SHA1 hash implementation, and specializations for standard containers and types. It provides mechanisms for combining hashes and generating SHA1 hashes, primarily used for generating unique identifiers.

classes.name: sha1
classes.description: Implements SHA1 hashing algorithm for strings, providing methods to process data and produce a 160-bit hash string.

classes.name: hash
classes.description: Template struct providing hash functions for various types, including specializations for tuples, pairs, vectors, and c10::complex.

methods.name: hash_combine
methods.description: Combines two hash values into one, based on Boost's implementation.

methods.name: sha1::reset
methods.description: Resets the SHA1 internal state to initial values.

methods.name: sha1::str
methods.description: Returns the SHA1 hash of the processed data as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_hash
methods.description: Variadic template function to compute combined hash of multiple arguments.
